ModMetaData.name: CombatExtended-SimpleSidearms Compatibility Module - Loadouts
ModMetaData.author: eebette
ModMetaData.description:
Unifies Combat Extended loadouts and Simple Sidearms memory into one mental model.
- Loadout weapons as sidearms: single-count weapons listed in a CE loadout are automatically remembered as sidearms by assigned pawns. The first in the list sets the default ranged / preferred melee role; the rest are backups. Remove one from the loadout and it is forgotten again — weapons you remembered manually are never touched. - Ammo for declared weapons: rides CE's own per-loadout "Ad hoc" checkbox. Ticked, it extends CE's primary-weapon ammo automation to every weapon declared in that loadout, at the loadout's magazine count. Unticked behaves exactly like vanilla CE. Hand-added caliber rows always win over the automation. - Optional full automation: settings can extend ammo demand and refetch to ALL remembered weapons, including battlefield pickups. Off by default.
Requires the CombatExtended-SimpleSidearms Compatibility Patch.
